issue: Mobile menu overlay backdrop only visible in top nav area, gets cut off below
root_cause: MobileNavOverlay component rendered inside <nav> element, constrained by nav's DOM hierarchy and dimensions
impact: Overlay backdrop doesn't cover full viewport; only visible at top; background content below header remains interactive

diagnosis.consequence: Overlay inherits nav's stacking context and is clipped by nav boundaries
diagnosis.visual_symptom: Dark overlay only visible in header area; cuts off below nav

solution.approach: Use React Portal to render overlay outside nav hierarchy directly to document.body

edits.change: Added mounted state and useEffect to set it to true
edits.reason: Ensures portal renders only on client after hydration

edits.change: Added early return: if (!mounted) return null
Wrapped overlay JSX in overlayContent variable
Changed return to: return createPortal(overlayContent, document.body)
edits.reason: Renders overlay directly to body, escaping nav constraints

before.issue: Overlay rendered inside nav, subject to nav's stacking context and dimensions

after.structure:
Header content
Overlay backdrop (z-999)
Menu panel (z-1000)
after.benefit: Overlay rendered at document.body level, full viewport coverage

expected_behavior: Dark background visible from top to bottom
No clipping or cut-off at nav boundary
Background content not interactive when menu open
test_steps: Verify dark overlay covers entire screen
Scroll menu content; overlay stays fixed

deployment.next_step: Reload dev server and test mobile menu on small viewport
